newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipina WW2 "sex slaves" to get more Japan aid.
newsitem.headline: Filipina WW2 "sex slaves" to get more Japan aid.

text.p: A privately funded Japanese women's group has signed an agreement with the Philippines to provide expanded humanitarian assistance to Filipinas used as "sex slaves" during World War Two, officials said on Thursday.
The programme is on top of the "atonement money" of $18,500 that the group, Asian Women's Fund, offered each woman last year, Philippine Social Welfare Department officials said.
Under the agreement, only those women who have accepted the atonement money offered by the Fund qualify for the assistance programme.

Only eight women have accepted the money of 169 who said they were sex slaves during the war. Most of the others rejected the offer and are demanding state reparation of $200,000 for each woman and an official apology from the Japanese government.

The agreement, signed in Manila on Wednesday, covers hospitalisation and other medical expenses, food and clothing, house repairs, water and electric bills, psychological counselling and other benefits.
The women are also entitled to wheelchairs, crutches, eyeglasses, and hearing aids if they need them.

Fund vice-president Makiko Arima, who signed the accord with Philippine Social Welfare Secretary Lina Laigo, pledged to expedite implementation of the programme, noting the "comfort women" were now in their twilight years.
Teenagers and young women when Japanese soldiers forced them into military brothels during the war, the women, popularly called "Lolas" (grandmothers), now range in age from 66 to their late 80s.
The programme will last for five years with a budget of 300,000 pesos ($11,500) for each woman.

Nelia Sancho, head of a group supporting the women's fight for state compensation, urged quick implementation of the agreement, saying some of the women were in poor health. One died two weeks after receiving the atonement money, one has cancer and another is paralysed and bed-ridden, she said.
